entities.name: Skullbriar
entities.description: Skullbriar the Walking Grave, a legendary zombie elemental formed from a necromancer and elementalist's pact.

events.summary: A necromancer and an elementalist weave their magics in an overgrown cemetery seeking eternal life, and are fused into Skullbriar.
events.quote: Instead, it fused them into Skullbriar, the relentless, restless elemental of death.
